label: Middle-aged farmer from Kansas
summary: Runs a family farm in Kansas and has no personal tie to Yale. Knows the name as a famous East Coast university and would only buy its apparel as a gift, for example for a relative or a neighbour's child who was admitted. Judges a product by whether it is well made, fairly priced, and plainly described.
life_stage: 45 to 60, self-employed, running a family farm
relationship_to_yale: None directly; knows Yale by reputation and through news and sport
yale_traditions_valued: A reputation for academic excellence that even people far from it recognise
A long history as one of the country's oldest universities
The achievement it represents when a young person from home gets in
yale_modern_values: Whether a place like Yale is open to students from rural and working families
Staying down to earth despite its standing
Service to the country and community, not only to its own graduates
buys_for: a young relative or family friend who was admitted to Yale
motivations: Mark a young person's achievement with a gift
Little reason to wear a school they have no connection to
decision_drivers: A garment that looks durable and well made
A seller that looks established and trustworthy
Simple ordering and delivery to a rural address
apparel_preferences: For themselves, the colours of local teams rather than a distant university
media_habits: Facebook, YouTube, local television, and radio
Watches on a phone in spare moments, often with the sound off
Gives an unfamiliar ad a few seconds to explain itself
cultural_references: Country music, college football, and rural life
Unlikely to recognise references to hip-hop music videos or internet memes
tone_that_resonates: Straightforward and honest about what is for sale
call_to_action_needs: What the product is and who it is for
How to order and how long delivery takes
turn_offs: Stylised imagery with no explanation of what is being sold
Anything that feels aimed only at city or campus insiders
appropriateness_concerns: Imagery that comes across as confrontational or intimidating
Any hint of talking down to rural or working people
